start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:method-design-a-feature on this request: let a bakery show how many loaves are left each morning." It runs seven sub-workflows in order and hands back each run_id and what it changed.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Write the feature in plain words, for example "Let a bakery show how many loaves are left each morning".
2. Say "Run workflow:method-design-a-feature" with that request; the AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run.

3. For each of its seven steps the AI starts the named sub-workflow with the same request (name-question-delete, contact-reality, find-the-constraints, test-a-design-against-every-case, build-the-real-thing, name-things-by-what-they-do, plan-only-what-helps), walks it to the end and hands back its run_id and the one thing it changed.
4. Read the last step, plan-only-what-helps, for the plan you build from.
